{{Top|leg}}
A '''boudoir''' located within the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Royal Palace]] of [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]] had been attributed to [[Rouge Organa]], one of the three sisters of [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]. In that small private room, Rouge Organa liked to have her [[Hair/Legends|hair]] dressed for dinner. The boudoir was equipped with a [[Gold/Legends|gilt]]-framed [[Mirror/Legends|mirror]].
